source_citations.reference: 42 U.S.C. 4336 - Procedure for determination of level of review
Council on Environmental Quality NEPA overview

permits.name: National Environmental Policy Act Environmental Review

explanations.trigger_explanation: A project with substantial federal control and responsibility commonly enters the National Environmental Policy Act process when there is a federal permit, approval, funding, or other discretionary federal action.

known_unknowns: Agency-specific categorical exclusions, environmental assessment procedures, and environmental impact statement thresholds vary by lead federal agency.
advisories: Additional review recommended to determine whether the project is categorically excluded, needs an environmental assessment, or needs an environmental impact statement.
notes: Confidence tier 1 because the trigger framework is directly supported by federal statute and official Council on Environmental Quality materials.
